ratings_why.fun: Four real builds from one Debt number and a clear tier climb, but most payoffs end in plain +1/+1 and the Skim line only grows when you're already winning.
ratings_why.distinct: Debt as a fight resource read three ways (Debt, Ledger, repayment count) plays unlike today's tribes; Skim itself is a familiar on-kill trigger.

verdict_why: Corbie's Grandchick's turn cap needs a clear ruling, and Penny Jackdaw doesn't do its Tier 1 tempo job; the rest can settle.

points.text: Corbie's Grandchick says "twice a turn", but most repayments happen in fights (Skims). Say whether the fight counts as part of the turn, and whether Thought and Memory's extra trigger uses up the cap.
Penny Jackdaw on turn 1 turns 3 gold into 2 that buy nothing. Borrow 3 would buy a second unit right away for a broke turn 2, which is the tribe's promise in one card.

Skim payoffs are win-more: losing a fight means few kills and a full bill. A small payoff when a Syndicate unit dies with Debt left (debts pass to the children) would give the losing side of the curve something.
If Belfry Mob plus Tower Raven or Slate-Drinker Rook turns out to be free gold every fight, the designer's own fix (Skimmed gold doesn't enter the Ledger, or Skim once a fight) keeps the idea.
Mr Magpie's "Each Start of Turn it isn't" reads better as "Each Start of Turn your Debt isn't repaid".

standouts.why: Mr Magpie makes a free board move into the moment you call the bill in; a readable, skill-testing decision.
Uncle Jack turns selling into repayment, rewards golden hunting and reaches every other tribe.
Hooded Crow Heavy wants Debt high but Skims it down; the tribe's tension in one card.

weakest.why: Penny Jackdaw's 2 gold rarely completes a purchase, so it's a 2/2 with a bill.
Slate-Drinker Rook loses gold on its own and only works once Skimmers exist.
Grandmother Corbie is a slow, generic tribe buff off a counter that only grows; little to play around.

flags.note: The Belfry Mob with Tower Raven, Slate-Drinker Rook and Silas Glint can make Borrow free, 4-6 gold a fight, capped only by Debt.
Thought and Memory with Arne or Sorrow and Joy doubles every repayment buff; a Mr Magpie lump of 12 is around 10 bodies.
Seven with The Belfry Mob buffs the whole tribe on every kill; a won fight could give about 7 times 7 stats.
Whether fight-time Skim repayments count toward "twice a turn" isn't stated.
